sections.title: Professional Maintenance Services
sections.text: Proper maintenance is essential to protect the condition and value of your building. Inland provides comprehensive maintenance to keep your property in top condition, safe, and comfortable to use, with solutions tailored to everything from homes to commercial buildings.

cards.title: Building Glass Cleaning
cards.text: Building glass cleaning is one of our flagship services. We use modern equipment and safe methods to keep your glass clean and your building looking its best — for offices, apartments, and other high-rise buildings.

items.title: Building Glass Cleaning
items.text: High-rise glass cleaning using safe, efficient rope access.

items.title: Exterior Wall Care
items.text: Facade cleaning and care to keep your building well maintained.

items.title: Interior Painting & Repair
items.text: Repainting and minor repairs to keep spaces comfortable.

sections.title: Safety Is Our Priority
sections.text: We understand how important safety is when working at height. Our technicians are fully equipped with protective gear and follow strict safety procedures.

sections.title: Schedule Your Building Maintenance
sections.text: Contact us for a site survey and our best quote.
